record.field: Import the donors, create the donation products, follow the patrons, thank everybody and invoice the donations.

field.name: description
field.p: Les Restos du Quartier is a food aid association: its volunteers collect food and serve meals in the neighbourhood, thanks to donors and patrons. Until now, everything was managed with spreadsheets and emails: help them move to Odoo.

div.p: Functional challenge: not a single line of code. Everything happens in the interface of Odoo, in the Contacts, Invoicing, CRM and Email Marketing apps.
The names to create are in bold: accents and capital letters do not matter. Click Check whenever you like: the tab Checker Report lists what is still missing.

Import the file donors.csv in the contacts: 10 donors, among which the company Boulangerie Kremer and its 2 contacts. Then tag them: Donor for all of them, Volunteer for Élise Bernard and Marc Kieffer, and Company for the bakery.
Create two services in a product category Donations: Free Donation, whose amount is chosen by the donor, and Membership Fee, sold 25.
The patrons are followed by a sales team Patronage, with a pipeline of 4 stages: Identified, Contacted, Proposal Sent and Signed. Create 3 opportunities in this team, and mark one of them as won.
Gather the 10 donors in a mailing list Donors, and send them a thank-you mailing.
💡 Contacts are added to a mailing list from the list of the contacts: menu Actions, Add to Mailing List.
Confirm 3 customer invoices to donors, for free donations or membership fees. Then analyse the invoices by donor in a pivot view, and save this analysis in your favorites.
💡 The analysis of the invoices is in the reporting of Invoicing, where the donor is the Partner. The favorites are saved from the menu of the search bar (Save search).

ul.li: A field Company Number on the contacts. 💡 With Studio, or in developer mode.
A 0 % tax on the two products.
An activity planned on an opportunity of the patrons.
The mailing really processed. 💡 The emails wait in a queue: run the scheduled action Mail Marketing: Process queue by hand.
